reviewer_type: AI-assisted researcher reading original text and actual records; not independent human annotation; no judge-model API

predicates.statement: Existing medical cases are embedded based on the medical ontology; a new-case-only relation is insufficient.
The set of experts is embedded based on the medical ontology.
The medical ontology is based on the Unified Medical Language System.

edge_criterion: Explicit record supporting each predicate through endpoint plus description semantics. Do not require an invented direct existing-case/expert-to-UMLS shortcut. Report entity-description retention separately from relation retention. Any multi-edge graph-path interpretation is labeled separately from explicit predicate-record retention. Require actual shared MedicalOntology node identity when reporting merged graph chain.
claim_dependency_secondary: Claim8 expressly depends on Claim4. Score explicit graph dependency separately; default graph absence is not technical relation loss.
retrieval: Record whether each original target quote appears in actually returned chunks; score graph/context predicate retention separately. Full original source claims outside retrieval do not count as retrieved evidence.
answer: Check existing-case and expert roles, ontology basis/UMLS, correct Claims4/8 attribution, publication/citation mapping, distinction of explicit chain and inference. Do not require verbose reasoning if explicit supported chain is correct.
invalid_samples: Any extraction finish_reason length, failed indexing, missing parser evidence or missing completed status is excluded or separately marked; cannot label as valid boundary loss.
causal_limits: Three repeated runs per condition, same model at temperature0 without guaranteed seed/determinism; no general causality claim.
Boundary changes chunk length and possibly token-budget utilization; inspect raw/parse/merge/retrieval stages before attribution.
Literal-anchor segregation does not guarantee removal of every inferential/semantic alternative cue.
